Due to this the user's battery lasts longer when connected to femtocell i.e. when indoors where the data requirement is high. As the paper progresses, typical challenges in femtocell and mitigation of interference to primary users will be discussed. Spectrum sensing and mobility are the crucial aspects which will discussed in cognitive femtocell network. Also the paper will focus on the upper layer issues like the transport layer. The paper will be concluded with the security aspect of cognitive femtocell network as security plays a vital role in wireless technology.

articleTitle: A robust perceptual colour image compression with watermarking
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: The development of multimedia and digital technology has led to the requirement of high quantity of data to represent images. Also multimedia security has become an important concern in the world of internet technology. These factors indicates the need for various image compression and security techniques. This paper focuses on compression scheme which makes use of the sensitivity of the Human Visual System. A robust watermarking method is also incorporated to add copyright protection to the image. The compression technique is optimized perceptually by making use of a Contrast Sensitivity Function (CSF). The technique is based on a wavelet transform technique known as Embedded Zerotree Wavelet (EZW) along with CSF quantization. A band average of CSF value is calculated for each subband which gives the quantization value for the transformed coefficients of that subband. The performance metric used are PSNR, CR, SSIM. Results shows that compression ratio is increased for the proposed method with a comparable PSNR and SSIM. Result is also evaluated based on subjective quality.

articleTitle: Towards a model for soa adoption based on methodical aspects
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: The process of SOA adoption take years to realize the benefits from initial SOA investments. A staged representation depicts the improvement path for SOA adoption. Each stage has its own characteristics and the stages are logically connected. The move from one stage to the next requires methods, processes, tools, and techniques. The existing methods mainly differ in terms of the centered building block; it is often challenge for an enterprise to decide on methods as the SOA motivations and requirements vary for different stages of SOA adoption. In this context, an enterprise has to model its SOA adoption path in terms of the methodical requirements at different stages. This work proposes a horseshoe model to understand the transformations from initial stages of SOA adoption to an optimized stage. The model is explained through three conceptual elements: (i) SOA building blocks, (ii) scope of method definition, and (iii) transformation views. This work guides to decide on SOA methods at different stages of adoption. The future work includes the model instantiation with required methods.

articleTitle: Different web configurations using wireless ad-hoc networks
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: A wireless ad-hoc network is an infrastructure-less network. The absence of an established infrastructure and central coordinator are the main features of this network. In this paper, we have discussed three different experimental scenarios in wireless ad-hoc networks performed by us in three consecutive sections. The flow of packets in an ad-hoc mode is shown at the beginning. Then, we are showing the effect of mobility to data transfer in ad-hoc mode. We are comparing two routing protocols-AODV and DYMO which are considered to be reactive and proactive respectively in the last section. All the experiments are performed by using QualNet software. Here we are showing the factors affecting the stationary nodes and the changes when stationary nodes are modified into mobile nodes. The simulation of routing of flow of packets using two different protocols has been compared.

articleTitle: A literature survey on RF MEMS packaging
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: This paper presents the survey of different packaging schemes of RF MEMS switches for wireless application. To determine the reliability of RF MEMS switch that tends to fails due to improper packaging, environmental conditions and improper housing and sealing. This paper describes the different types of RF MEMS switch packaging for d.c to millimeter wave application and is often chosen for high degree of integration, high reliability and enormous advantage over Relay, PIN diode and FET. In this paper, we discuss the MEMS switch packaging, various types of substrate used for designing and the literature survey which we had done.

articleTitle: Parabola structure based information gathering using AUV for underwater sensor network
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: This paper intends to provide an energy efficient parabolic structure based information gathering to enhance the network life of Underwater Sensor Networks (UWSN). In UWSN, sensor nodes closer to the sink node diminish energy sooner since they share larger load of packets relay. This problem worsens when water to be monitored is very deep which is also known as hotspot problem. Hence in this paper an effort has been made to mitigate imbalance in the energy consumption using a parabolic structure. Existing studies deals with multi-hop data transmission in a network. Proposed method creates a parabolic structure in all three layers such as surface layer, middle layer, bottom layer and sensed data is collected at the parabolic head nodes[PHN]. Further data is sent to surface sink node using Autonomous Underwater Vehicle[AUV]. AUV travels in a predefined path to collect the data from parabolic head nodes [PHN] from each layer. Proposed method is to improve the problem of unbalanced energy consumption. Simulation results show that the proposed model effectively and uniformly balances the energy consumption and thereby increasing network lifetime.

articleTitle: An enhanced ICI reduction scheme for CDD ofdm systems for IQ imbalance
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: In this paper, we develop the ICI selfcancellation scheme for reducing the effect of IQ imbalance in CDD OFDM systems. I/Q imbalance results reduction in CDD OFDM systems performance by creating an image signal interference which increases the power of interchannel interference (ICI). Here, an Enhanced Symmetric data conjugate (ESDC) method is developed by mapping the transmitted symbol at the spacing of half of the CDD OFDM symbol block. The symbol mapping in the proposed ESDC enhances the received SNR and thereby improves the CDD OFDM performance. The proposed ESDC scheme reduces the power of interchannel interference (ICI) due to image signal interference of IQ imbalance.
